question: Where can I find a stadium that fall within 150 kilometers of TECHealth | ER Staffing, EMR & ER Partnerships, Chandler, AZ?
sql: SELECT poi_name AS name FROM pois WHERE leisure = 'stadium' AND ST_DWithin(geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%TECHealth | ER Staffing, EMR & ER Partnerships, Chandler, AZ%' LIMIT 1)::geography, 150000) UNION ALL SELECT park_name AS name FROM parks WHERE leisure = 'stadium' AND ST_DWithin(geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%TECHealth | ER Staffing, EMR & ER Partnerships, Chandler, AZ%' LIMIT 1)::geography, 150000);
